records.title: Burkina Faso Agricultural Transformation Project — US$215.9 million
records.description: World Bank project supporting agricultural productivity, value chains, processing, market access and private investment in Burkina Faso.

records.title: SAVIG — Sustainable Agricultural Value-chains Intensification for Growth
records.description: US$40 million World Bank IDA grant supporting agricultural value chains, productivity, private investment, jobs, market links and food security in Sierra Leone.

records.title: Nigeria National Agrifood Systems Investment Plan (NASIP) 2026–2027
records.description: Nigeria's two-year ₦6.5 trillion agrifood investment plan, informed by FAO MAFAP evidence on public spending and policy optimization.

records.title: THRIVE — soil restoration, farm diversification and inclusive value chains
records.description: CGIAR THRIVE work in Ethiopia connects soil restoration, crop diversification, resilient planting material, indigenous crops and inclusive markets.

records.title: THRIVE — soil restoration, farm diversification and inclusive value chains
records.description: CGIAR THRIVE work in Kenya connects soil restoration, crop diversification, resilient planting material, indigenous crops and inclusive markets.

records.title: THRIVE — soil restoration, farm diversification and inclusive value chains
records.description: CGIAR THRIVE work in Uganda connects soil restoration, crop diversification, resilient planting material, indigenous crops and inclusive markets.

records.title: IITA–IER climate-smart agriculture evidence base
records.description: IITA and partners studied climate-smart agriculture practices among 3,709 households and 8,391 plots across six regions of Mali.

records.title: Ghana Market Access and Connectivity Project — US$500 million
records.description: World Bank financing to improve rural road connectivity, agricultural market access and value chains, benefiting farmers and rural communities.

records.title: Guinea Commercial Agriculture Development Project Phase II — US$116 million
records.description: World Bank financing for commercial agriculture development aimed at commercialization, private investment, employment and stronger agricultural value chains.

records.title: Senegal index-based agricultural insurance coverage
records.description: World Bank results report more than 835,000 farmers and breeders covered by index-based agricultural insurance against drought and rainfall shocks in 2025.

records.title: The Gambia digital seed and fertilizer distribution support
records.description: World Bank results report improved rice and maize seed distribution through a digitally managed platform, alongside fertilizer support and climate-smart farming services.

records.title: Guinea warehouse receipt and agricultural market systems
records.description: World Bank results highlight a strengthened warehouse receipt system, 100 approved warehouses and new index-based insurance protecting farmers and breeders against drought and poor rainfall.

records.title: Côte d'Ivoire e-Agriculture digital marketplace
records.description: The World Bank reports that Côte d'Ivoire's e-Agriculture project benefited more than 400,000 people in selected agricultural value chains through improved market access and information.

records.title: Benin Digital Rural Transformation agricultural machinery platform
records.description: Benin's digital rural transformation work includes platforms for agricultural machinery management, crop advisory services and farm monitoring using geospatial data.

records.title: Cameroon agricultural e-voucher system
records.description: Cameroon's digital transformation project enrolled producers into an electronic voucher system supporting fertilizer and seed subsidies.

records.title: Uganda hides, skins and leather processing — US$70.66M
records.description: FAO's Uganda 2026 Hand-in-Hand profile identifies a US$70.66 million investment case for central tanneries and leather manufacturing, with a private financing gap of about US$24 million.

records.title: Zimbabwe maize investment case — US$468M
records.description: FAO's Zimbabwe 2026 Hand-in-Hand profile identifies a US$468 million maize investment case spanning irrigation, mechanization, water infrastructure, seed breeding, soil health and integrated pest management.

records.title: Zambia SIFAZ Matching Grant Facility — grants of €400 to €60,000
records.description: FAO's SIFAZ Matching Grant Facility supports eligible Zambian farmers, cooperatives and agribusinesses in mechanization, input acquisition and marketing, commodity aggregation and green enterprise promotion. The 2nd call opened in May 2026 with beneficiary co-financing requirements.

records.title: Zambia Farmer Field Schools — practical extension for vulnerable farming households
records.description: FAO and government partners are establishing at least 90 Farmer Field Schools across six districts, potentially reaching up to 2,700 farmers with practical production, plant health, climate-smart agriculture and disaster-risk learning.

records.title: Zambia Integrated Agricultural Management Information System (ZIAMIS)
records.description: FAO-supported STOSAR II work is strengthening Zambia's agricultural information management, data quality, interoperability and digital decision-making through assessment and strengthening of ZIAMIS and the National AIMS Technical Committee.

records.title: Angola community reservoirs and solar irrigation within Southern Africa regional initiative
records.description: FAO's 2026 Southern Africa initiative identifies Angola as a target country for small reservoirs and renewable-energy irrigation supporting soybean, rice and other priority value chains.

records.title: Mozambique irrigation and rice infrastructure within Southern Africa regional initiative
records.description: FAO's 2026 Southern Africa initiative targets Mozambique for community reservoirs, irrigation equipment and rice production and milling investments.

records.title: Malawi irrigation and rice infrastructure within Southern Africa regional initiative
records.description: FAO's 2026 Southern Africa initiative targets Malawi for community reservoirs, renewable-energy irrigation and rice value-chain development.

records.title: Zambia mechanization hire-service hubs within Southern Africa regional initiative
records.description: FAO's 2026 Southern Africa initiative identifies Zambia as a target for mechanization hire-service hubs supporting soybean production and smallholder access to machinery.

records.title: Zimbabwe mechanization hire-service hubs within Southern Africa regional initiative
records.description: FAO's 2026 Southern Africa initiative targets Zimbabwe for mechanization services supporting wheat and other priority agricultural production.

records.title: Botswana agroprocessing and regional market integration within Southern Africa initiative
records.description: FAO's 2026 Southern Africa initiative includes Botswana in regional agroprocessing and market-integration activities, including wheat-flour value addition.

records.title: Eswatini cotton value addition within Southern Africa regional initiative
records.description: FAO's 2026 Southern Africa initiative identifies Eswatini for cotton lint, yarn and fibre value addition through regional agroprocessing infrastructure.

records.title: Lesotho cotton value addition within Southern Africa regional initiative
records.description: FAO's 2026 Southern Africa initiative identifies Lesotho for cotton value addition and regional agroprocessing infrastructure.

records.title: Namibia wheat value addition within Southern Africa regional initiative
records.description: FAO's 2026 Southern Africa initiative identifies Namibia for wheat-flour processing within regional agroprocessing zones.

records.title: Ghana RECSOIL soil-health and soil-carbon programme
records.description: FAO and Ghana's CSIR–Soil Research Institute are supporting farmers in the Upper West Region to assess soils, improve soil fertility, strengthen soil organic carbon and apply sustainable soil-management practices.

records.title: Ghana climate-smart soybean demonstration farms
records.description: FAO trained 50 agricultural extension agents to establish 100 climate-smart soybean demonstration farms across six districts and support training for about 10,000 smallholder soybean farmers.

records.title: Ghana national aflatoxin surveillance and food-safety initiative
records.description: FAO, the Government of Ghana and the National Codex Committee launched an initiative to strengthen aflatoxin surveillance through standardized monitoring and data collection for food safety, policy and trade.

records.title: Feed Ghana poultry support with 150,000 birds
records.description: FAO and the European Union provided 150,000 poultry birds, feed and training to farmers in northern Ghana to boost local production and strengthen food security and rural livelihoods.

records.title: Ghana Fall Armyworm integrated pest-management support
records.description: FAO support in Ghana promotes integrated pest management through farmer training, demonstration trials, Farmer Field Schools and national biological-control capacity to reduce reliance on chemical pesticides.

records.title: Ghana SoilFER wet-chemistry laboratory capacity programme
records.description: FAO's SoilFER programme trained 38 laboratory technicians and experts in Ghana on harmonized soil-analysis methods, strengthening reliable soil data for sustainable agriculture and resilient agrifood systems.

records.title: Ghana ESTELLA crop-monitoring and farmer-registry data initiative
records.description: FAO and regional partners are strengthening the use of Earth Observation and farmer registries for crop monitoring and validated agricultural data, supporting early warning and climate-risk management.

records.title: Ghana Cocoa Monitor data-sharing and sustainability platform
records.description: The Ghana Cocoa Monitor brings public and private stakeholders together to strengthen coordination, transparency, data sharing and evidence-based action across Ghana's cocoa value chain.

records.title: Ghana cocoa swollen shoot virus disease management strategy
records.description: A regional strategy coordinated in Abidjan sets a five-year approach to cocoa swollen shoot virus disease through farm rehabilitation, monitoring, research and stronger collaboration.

records.title: Ghana poultry and aquaculture antimicrobial-resistance reduction roadmap
records.description: Ghanaian stakeholders developed a national roadmap under FAO's RENOFARM initiative to reduce inappropriate antimicrobial use, strengthen disease prevention and veterinary services, and promote responsible use.

records.title: Ghana Farmer Field Schools for antimicrobial-resistance prevention
records.description: FAO and Ghana's Ministry of Food and Agriculture graduated 210 poultry farmers and 14 facilitators through a Farmer Field School approach focused on biosecurity and responsible antimicrobial use.

records.title: Kenya Soil Partnership, Soil Laboratory Network and Soil Doctors Programme
records.description: Kenya launched national soil-governance and farmer soil-intelligence initiatives under SoilFER, including a national soil partnership, laboratory network and rollout of the Soil Doctors Programme.
records.type: Soil health and agricultural research programme

records.title: Uganda REDD+ Results-Based Payment Project — US$31 million
records.description: FAO reports a US$31 million Green Climate Fund results-based payment project supporting sustainable land management, agroforestry, forest restoration and resilient rural livelihoods.

records.title: Nigeria Emergency and Resilience Plan 2026–2028
records.description: FAO's Nigeria Emergency and Resilience Plan 2026–2028 combines agricultural inputs, livelihood restoration, market access and resilience support for crisis-affected farmers, pastoralists, fishers and agro-processors.

records.title: Côte d'Ivoire Hand-in-Hand agrifood investment portfolio — US$121.9 million
records.description: FAO's 2026 Côte d'Ivoire investment profile contains nine agrifood investment cases across three Integrated Agro-Industrial Pole programmes, with US$121.9 million in total investment.

records.title: Côte d'Ivoire climate adaptation and resilience through SAGA 2
records.description: FAO's SAGA 2 programme in Côte d'Ivoire supports climate adaptation, sustainable agriculture and resilient rural livelihoods through locally grounded approaches.

records.title: Côte d'Ivoire National Agriculture Census
records.description: Côte d'Ivoire and FAO launched preparations for the National Agriculture Census to strengthen agricultural statistics, planning and evidence-based investment.

records.title: Côte d'Ivoire warehouse receipt and agricultural market systems
records.description: Côte d'Ivoire is strengthening agricultural market infrastructure and warehouse-receipt systems as part of wider efforts to improve market access, transparency and value-chain financing.
records.source: Ministry of Agriculture of Côte d'Ivoire

records.title: Japan–Ethiopia ETB 375 million grant for rice-sector mechanization
records.description: Japan and Ethiopia signed a grant agreement for agricultural machinery and equipment including combine harvesters, tractors, rice-milling machines and land-preparation equipment.

records.title: Ethiopia emergency agricultural and livestock resilience support
records.description: FAO's 2026 emergency and resilience programme targets agricultural and livestock assistance amid drought, flooding, conflict, economic shocks, pests and disease.

records.title: Ethiopia national agrifood transformation roadmap
records.description: FAO and Ethiopia's Ministry of Agriculture have been aligning the FAO Global Roadmap's domains and actions with national priorities for food security and climate-resilient agrifood transformation.

records.title: Ethiopia agricultural knowledge and digital extension support
records.description: FAO's Ethiopia Hand-in-Hand work identifies Digital Green as a partner for disseminating agricultural knowledge to farmers and supporting evidence-based agricultural transformation.

records.title: Sierra Leone Feed Salone aggregation, processing and marketing implementation plan
records.description: FAO-supported implementation planning for Feed Salone Pillar 3 focuses on aggregation, processing and marketing, with targets for rice milling, eggs, onion, cassava and cashew value chains.

records.title: Sierra Leone 2024 Annual Agricultural Survey microdata
records.description: The 2024 Annual Agricultural Survey microdata are publicly available through the national NADA platform, supporting evidence-based agricultural policy and analysis.

records.title: Sierra Leone agrifood investor and finance engagement platform
records.description: The 2025 Agrifood Investor Summit brought together international and regional investors, development finance institutions and domestic agrifood firms across priority value chains including rice, cassava, cocoa, cashew, poultry, feed grains and palm oil.

records.title: Sierra Leone Ministry of Agriculture market prices, extension and investment information
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture and Food Security's official portal provides farmers and agribusinesses with agricultural extension, market prices, investment opportunities and partnership information.
records.source: Ministry of Agriculture and Food Security

records.title: Angola Hand-in-Hand agrifood investment portfolio — US$1.17 billion
records.description: FAO's 2026 Angola investment profile presents four major agrifood cases—coffee, avocado, palm oil and soybean—with total proposed investment of US$1.17 billion.

records.title: Angola avocado, citrus and palm-oil value-chain studies
records.description: FAO and Angola's government are validating evidence-based studies on avocado, citrus and palm oil to guide strategic investment, processing, logistics and export development.

records.title: Angola food-balance-sheet statistical capacity programme
records.description: FAO and Angola's Ministry of Agriculture and Forestry conducted training and compilation work to strengthen national Food Balance Sheets and evidence-based food-policy analysis.

records.title: Angola Country Programming Framework 2024–2028
records.description: FAO's Angola framework supports agrifood systems transformation, family farming and value chains, environmental sustainability, and disaster-risk management in alignment with Angola 2050 and the 2023–2027 National Development Plan.

records.title: Benin Third-Generation National Agricultural Investment and Food and Nutrition Security Plan (PNIASAN)
records.description: FAO's Hand-in-Hand support in Benin is helping implement the third generation of PNIASAN and plan priority agricultural investments with the Ministry of Agriculture, Livestock and Fisheries.

records.title: Benin 2026 cereal input and production support
records.description: FAO's 2026 country brief reports government and partner support through seed and fertilizer distribution and input subsidies, alongside active planting of maize, rice and other cereals.

records.title: Cabo Verde climate adaptation of agrifood systems — US$2.64 million programme
records.description: FAO's country portfolio includes a 2025–2029 climate-change adaptation programme designed to improve food security and rural livelihoods.

records.title: Cabo Verde VI General Agricultural Census
records.description: The sixth General Agricultural Census collects updated information on rainfed and irrigated production, livestock, forests, farmer organizations, labour and rural living conditions.

records.title: Cabo Verde ENSANS 2035 sustainable food-systems strategy
records.description: Cabo Verde's National Strategy for Food and Nutrition Security and Sustainable Food Systems to 2035 emphasizes territorial governance, local production, resilience, nutrition and reduced external dependency.
